query:
select
            p.id,
            p.group_id,
            p.kind::text as "kind!",
            p.image_id,
            images.url as "image_url?",
            p.name as "name!: DIS",
            p.description as "description!: DIS",
            (select base.price from product_base_prices base
                where base.product_id = p.id) as "price!",
            (select coalesce(array_agg(bk.category order by bk.id), '{}'::uuid[])
                from product_base_prices base
                inner join product_addon_option_bookkeepings bk on bk.option_id = base.option_id
                where base.product_id = p.id) as "bookkeeping_tag_ids!: Vec<Uuid>",
            (select coalesce(array_agg(bk.price order by bk.id), '{}'::money[])
                from product_base_prices base
                inner join product_addon_option_bookkeepings bk on bk.option_id = base.option_id
                where base.product_id = p.id) as "bookkeeping_prices!: Vec<i64>",
            p.sales_organization,
            p.sales_stock,
            p.stock_real,
            p.stock_unit,
            p.stock_price::float8 as "stock_price!",
            p.max_uses,
            p.sales_start,
            p.sales_stop,
            p.resale_start,
            p.resale_stop,
            p.store_general_sales,
            p.store_online_self_serve,
            p.store_internal_id,
            p.store_alcohol_by_volume,
            p.tickets_guaranteed,
            p.tickets_require_other,
            p.tickets_been_released,
            p.been_purchased,
            array(select activity_id from product_activity_assignments
                where product_id = p.id order by activity_id) as "activity_ids!: Vec<Uuid>",
            array(select group_id from product_transfer_groups
                where product_id = p.id order by group_id) as "transfer_group_ids!: Vec<Uuid>",
            array(select group_id from product_allowed_groups
                where product_id = p.id order by group_id) as "allowed_group_ids!: Vec<Uuid>",
            array(select addon_id from product_addon_links
                where product_id = p.id order by addon_id) as "addon_ids!: Vec<Uuid>"
        from products p
        left join images on images.id = p.image_id
        where p.id = $1
